# Atlassian

> Atlassian provides AI-powered collaboration and work management software for software teams, IT operations, and enterprises.

Atlassian's platform includes flagship products like Jira for project management, Confluence for knowledge collaboration, and Rovo for enterprise AI search. The company offers integrated collections and specialized tools for software development, IT service management, strategic planning, and team productivity.

## Key Topics

- Jira
- Confluence
- Rovo
- Bitbucket
- AI-powered
- Project Management
- Team Collaboration
- Knowledge Management
- CI/CD
- Service Management
- Enterprise Planning
- Automation
- Jira Service Management
- Rovo Dev
- Internal Developer Platform

## Core Products

- [Jira](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira): Jira project management platform with AI agents for planning and tracking.
- [Confluence](https://www.atlassian.com/software/confluence): Confluence AI workspace for knowledge management and team collaboration.
- [Rovo](https://www.atlassian.com/software/rovo): Rovo GenAI product for enterprise search, chat, and specialized agents.
- [Bitbucket](https://www.atlassian.com/software/bitbucket): Bitbucket code repository with CI/CD and Jira integration.

## Product Collections

- [Teamwork Collection](https://www.atlassian.com/collections/teamwork): Teamwork Collection bundle: Jira, Confluence, Loom, and Rovo agents.
- [Software Collection](https://www.atlassian.com/collections/software): Software Collection for developer productivity with Rovo Dev and Bitbucket.
- [Service Collection](https://www.atlassian.com/collections/service): Service Collection for IT and customer service management solutions.
- [Strategy Collection](https://www.atlassian.com/collections/strategy): Strategy Collection for enterprise planning with Focus, Talent, and Align.

## Service & Support Solutions

- [Jira Service Management](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/service-management): Jira Service Management for IT support and employee service delivery.
- [Customer Service Management](https://www.atlassian.com/software/customer-service-management): Jira Customer Service Management with omnichannel support.

## Developer & Technical Tools

- [Rovo Dev](https://www.atlassian.com/software/rovo-dev): Rovo Dev agentic AI for software delivery and developer productivity.
- [Bitbucket Pipelines](https://www.atlassian.com/software/bitbucket/features/pipelines): Bitbucket Pipelines CI/CD automation with deployment visibility.
- [Compass](https://www.atlassian.com/software/compass): Compass internal developer platform for service catalog and health metrics.

## Enterprise & Strategic Planning

- [Focus](https://www.atlassian.com/software/focus): Atlassian Focus for strategic planning and goal management.
- [Talent](https://www.atlassian.com/software/talent): Atlassian Talent for strategic workforce planning and resource allocation.
- [Jira Product Discovery](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/product-discovery): Jira Product Discovery for idea management and roadmapping.

## Collaboration & Communication

- [Loom](https://www.atlassian.com/software/loom): Loom AI-powered video messaging for async team communication.

## Security & Governance

- [Atlassian Guard](https://www.atlassian.com/software/guard): Atlassian Guard for cloud security and zero-trust access management.

## Company & Overview

- [Atlassian Homepage](https://www.atlassian.com): Atlassian homepage showcasing Jira, Confluence, and team collaboration products.
